# Plan 0002 source-leaf ownership.
#
# One row per source leaf this plan's scaffold task creates. Columns are
# separated by a vertical bar:
#
#   source path | owning package | leaf family | structural parent | module path
#
# A leaf family names the boundary the leaf belongs to and is bound to exactly
# one package, so a leaf placed in the wrong crate fails even when its path and
# module path agree with each other. The structural parent is the crate root or
# family root whose `pub mod` declaration reaches the leaf; exactly one parent
# may declare a leaf. Rows are byte-lexicographically ordered by source path so
# the fixture's order never depends on the order the source tree is walked.
#
# This file, the parent declarations, the source tree, and the scaffold task's
# recorded footprint are compared in both directions, so an undeclared source
# file, a declaration without a file, a duplicate, a misowned leaf, and a second
# parent are each rejected.
